content.title: Can Trump and Big Pharma Get the World to Pay More for Drugs?
content.summary: Americans pay about three times what other wealthy nations do for branded prescription drugs.  For years, policymakers have tried to fix this by cutting U.S. drug prices directly.  President Trump has pushed a different idea: make foreign countries pay more so Americans can pay less.
